limits: This is a disclosed retrospective engineering result, not completion of the original registered run or fresh confirmation.
The eight probabilities explicitly supply an answer code. The writer did not identify the requested rule, perform planning or execute the learned energy module.
Cached-vector compatibility is not a live energy-module transplant. The reader remains offline and has not been connected to the writer.
The result establishes no text generation, full-vocabulary top choice, probability calibration, composition, unseen-rule transfer or novelty.
The successful new writer does not isolate why the earlier joint bridge failed; architecture, supervision and optimization differ.
The numerical checker verified saved forward arithmetic and weight records; it did not replay backpropagation or the optimizer.
The earlier learning failures and all original STOP records remain unchanged.
